subject: Post‑discovery: pick a 30‑min intro + who to invite
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@curahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps after our discovery — 30m intro options

Hi Liam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a short product intro on the calendar.

Recap (2 min):
- You want a low‑latency, cost‑predictable inference path for your clinical NLP pipelines and an audit trail for PHI handling.
- Top priorities: predictable token cost, on‑prem/private deployment option (VPC), and role‑based access for models.
- Key stakeholders: product (you), infra/security, and a technical owner for evaluation.

Proposal: a 30‑minute product intro (high level + quick Q&A). Please pick one of these windows — all times PT: 
1) Wed 6 Oct — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Thu 7 Oct — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Fri 8 Oct — 09:00–09:30 PT

Suggested agenda (30m):
- 5m: goals & success criteria (we want to confirm the evaluation metric)
- 15m: demo of Redwood hosted + dedicated config for clinical workloads
- 5m: security/compliance callouts (private deployment, KMS) — Monica will cover
- 5m: next steps & timeline (pilot options, POC scope)

Also: could you confirm who from your side should join? We recommend product + an infra/security engineer + a technical owner (platform/ML). If any of those are not needed, tell us and we’ll tailor the agenda.

Attaching a short briefing deck and a draft one‑page agenda for the session.

Thanks — I’ll hold the three windows tentatively and send a calendar invite once you confirm.

—
Marissa Cole
